outcome: Hormone levels (TSH, FSH, LH, E2, PRL)
finding: Women who underwent tubal ligation during caesarean section did not experience significant differences in hormone levels, dysmenorrhea, or dyspareunia compared to those who did not undergo tubal ligation, except for an increased incidence of menstrual cycle irregularity.
mod_finding: Women who underwent tubal ligation during caesarean section had a higher incidence of menstrual cycle irregularity compared to those who did not undergo tubal ligation.
